name: glycerin + phenylephrine + pramoxine + white petrolatum
purpose: Purpose Protectant Vasoconstrictor Local anesthetic Protectant
uses: Uses • for temporary relief of pain, soreness and burning • helps relieve the local itching and discomfort associated with hemorrhoids • temporarily provides a coating for relief of anorectal discomforts • temporarily protects the inflamed irritated anorectal surface to help make bowel movements less painful • temporarily shrinks hemorrhoidal tissue
otcwarn: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are • heart disease • high blood pressure • thyroid disease • diabetes • difficulty in urination due to enlargement of the prostate gland Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are • presently taking a prescription drug for high blood pressure or depression. Stop use and ask a doctor if bleeding occurs condition worsens or does not improve within 7 days the symptoms being treated do not subside or if redness, irritation, swelling, pain or other symptoms develop or increase. some people can develop allergic reactions to ingredients in this product.
